set.label: Medical debt on consumer credit reports

edits.claim: fallback stat: $88B annual US medical bad debt (KFF estimate)
edits.src: CFPB March 2022 report (Community Catalyst / CFS Law Monitor coverage, search 2026-10-09): $88 billion of medical debt on consumer credit records as of June 2021 — not a KFF "annual bad debt" estimate; KFF Health Care Debt Survey 2022: 41% of adults have health care debt (kept)
